scope_of_this_part: The battery v4 tables at matched achieved error belong to a later node. This part judges the two operator discriminators (second-order spatial convergence, conservation <= 1e-12) and records the battery design and a smoke run labelled smoke. Nothing is promoted, routed or selected by default.

discretisation_conventions.cartesian: uniform cell-centred finite volumes on [0, L_a] per axis, h_a = L_a / N_a, cell centres x = (i + 1/2) h, x-fastest layout index = s + S (i + Nx (j + Ny k)) with S species interleaved; boundary per axis: Periodic (wrap), NeumannZero (zero face flux, ghost = cell value), DirichletZero (face value 0 by linear interpolation, ghost = -cell value)
discretisation_conventions.sphere: latitude-longitude finite volumes with the conventions of the facade module crates/vigilode/src/spatial.rs on branch research/stage-lattice-referee-20261124 (read, not edited): Nt colatitude rings of width pi/Nt, Np longitudes of width 2 pi/Np, longitude-fastest layout index = ring Np + j, exact ring areas R^2 dphi 2 sin(dtheta/2) sin(theta_mid), zero flux through the zero-length polar faces, periodic longitude; the two pole rings are first order (stated in the rustdoc and tested)
discretisation_conventions.upwind_advection: constant velocity per axis, first-order upwind flux F = a+ u_left + a- u_right in conservative form; Periodic or DirichletZero (zero inflow) per axis; declared first order
discretisation_conventions.burgers: scalar viscous Burgers u_t + sum_a d_a(u^2/2) = nu Laplacian u with the Engquist-Osher flux (max(uL,0)^2 + min(uR,0)^2)/2, conservative, Periodic or DirichletZero per axis; declared first order (upwind flux)
discretisation_conventions.reaction_diffusion: Gray-Scott, 2D Brusselator, Allen-Cahn, sine-Gordon on the Cartesian Laplacian with pointwise reaction terms, species interleaved; declared second order

C1_cartesian_second_order.role: frozen discriminator 'second-order spatial convergence' for the Cartesian Laplacians
C1_cartesian_second_order.metric: max-norm error of the discrete Helmholtz solution: solve (I - L_h) u_h = f_h by conjugate gradients on the operator's apply_into (relative residual <= 1e-13), f = u - sum_a D_a d_aa u sampled at cell centres, error e = max_i |u_h,i - u(x_i)| / max_i |u(x_i)|
C1_cartesian_second_order.manufactured_solution: u = product over active axes of g_a(x_a) with g = exp(sin(2 pi x / L)) for Periodic, g = exp(cos(pi x / L)) for NeumannZero, g = sin(pi x / L) exp(x / L) for DirichletZero
C1_cartesian_second_order.observed_order: p_k = log2(e_k / e_(k+1)) for each consecutive pair of the ladder
C1_cartesian_second_order.secondary_reported_not_judged: max-norm truncation error of L_h on the smooth periodic field (orders reported); exactness of discrete eigenvectors (Fourier for Periodic, cos(k pi (i+1/2)/N) for NeumannZero, sin(k pi (i+1/2)/N) for DirichletZero): max |L_h v - lambda_h v| <= 1e-10 |lambda_h| max |v| asserted as a contract test

C2_sphere_second_order_away_from_poles.role: frozen discriminator 'second-order spatial convergence' for the sphere, away from the poles; poles reported separately
C2_sphere_second_order_away_from_poles.grid: radius R = 2, diffusivity D = 0.5, Nt in [16, 32, 64, 128], Np = 2 Nt
C2_sphere_second_order_away_from_poles.metric_band: max over cells whose centre colatitude lies in [pi/6, 5 pi/6] of |L_h Y - lambda Y| / (|lambda| max_all |Y|), lambda = -D l (l + 1) / R^2
C2_sphere_second_order_away_from_poles.pass_rule: every consecutive observed order in the band >= 1.9 for every mode
C2_sphere_second_order_away_from_poles.pole_rings_reported_separately: max over the first and the last ring of the same relative error, with orders; contract test of the stated first-order pole behaviour: for Y11 every consecutive pole-ring order lies in [0.8, 1.2] (prior evidence: U09 measured 0.98 and 0.99)
C2_sphere_second_order_away_from_poles.also_reported: full-sphere weighted L2 relative error per mode (no rule)

C3_conservation.metric: defect = |sum_i w_i f_i(u)| / sum_i w_i sum_j |J_ij(u)| |u_j|, both sums Neumaier-compensated, with w the declared quadrature weights and J the operator's assembled Jacobian at u (the scale is the weighted sum of the absolute contributions entering every cell)
C3_conservation.pass_rule: defect <= 1e-12 for every conservative operator, every grid of the ladders of C1 and C2 and both fields
fields: the smooth manufactured field of C1 or a degree-2 harmonic combination on the sphere
conservative_operators: Cartesian Laplacian with Periodic or NeumannZero on every axis (1D, 2D, 3D, anisotropic box)
upwind advection with Periodic on every axis
Burgers with Periodic on every axis
declared_not_conservative: reaction terms of Gray-Scott, Brusselator, Allen-Cahn, sine-Gordon
C3_conservation.also_reported: absolute |sum_i w_i f_i(u)| for the O(1) fields

checks: linear operators: jvp_into(v) equals apply_into(v) bit for bit
assembled Jacobian (pattern values) times v against jvp_into: max |J v - jvp| <= 1e-12 max_i sum_j |J_ij| |v_j|
central finite difference with delta = 1e-6 max(1, max|u|) / max|v|: max |FD - jvp| <= 1e-6 max_i sum_j |J_ij| |v_j|
C4_jvp.sizes: 1D 20 cells, 2D 12 x 10, 3D 6 x 5 x 4, sphere 8 x 16; every boundary type

C5_structure.weights: every weight finite and > 0; per species the weights sum to the domain measure (box volume, 4 pi R^2) within 1e-12 relative
C5_structure.stencil_radius: declared 1 for every operator of this part
C5_structure.bandwidth_and_pattern: every pattern entry lies inside the declared (lower, upper) bandwidth, the diagonal is in the pattern, and on the small sizes of C4 the dense Jacobian built column by column from jvp_into is zero outside the pattern
C5_structure.allocation: apply_into, jvp_into and jacobian_values_into make no allocation request (counting global allocator, test binary mol_alloc.rs with one test)

C6_certificate.procedure: certify_weighted_self_adjoint: refused for a nonlinear operator; otherwise assemble J and, with H = diag(w): for every pattern pair, |w_i J_ij - w_j J_ji| <= 64 eps max(|w_i J_ij|, |w_j J_ji|) (else refused as asymmetric); for every row of S = (HJ + (HJ)^T)/2: S_ii + sum_(j != i) |S_ij| <= 64 eps (|S_ii| + sum_(j != i) |S_ij|) (else refused as not dissipative); eps = f64::EPSILON
C6_certificate.expected: issued for every Cartesian Laplacian (all boundaries, 1D, 2D, 3D, anisotropic box) and the sphere; refused for upwind advection (weighted asymmetry) and for every nonlinear operator
C6_certificate.independent_check: random vectors as in U09: for an issued certificate |u'HLv - v'HLu| / scale <= 1e-12 and max u'HLu / u'Hu <= 1e-12 |lambda_max scale|; for upwind advection the symmetry defect is reported (> 1e-3 expected)

S_sparse_lu_client.client: crates/rodas5p-integrators/src/stage_clients/sparse_lu.rs, type SparseLuStageClient over rodas5p_core::SparseDirectSolver: pattern and symbolic analysis once at construction, Jacobian values through a fill callback in linearize, W = I/(h gamma) - J on the pattern and one numeric factorisation per factor call, SparseDirectSolver solves
S_sparse_lu_client.S1_bit_reproducibility: two runs of integrate_rodas5p_fast_client_observed_with_atol with fresh clients on the same problem: every output state bit for bit, attempts, accepted and rejected steps and the whole WorkCounters value equal

S2_dense_comparison.reference_client: DenseLuStageClient with the protected choice of LU mode, JVP-built dense Jacobian
cases: 1D heat DirichletZero, 40 cells, D = 1, t in [0, 0.1]
S2_dense_comparison.tolerance: rtol = atol = 1e-6, outputs at 5 equally spaced times
S2_dense_comparison.bound: accepted and rejected step counts equal, and max over outputs and components of |y_sparse - y_dense| / (atol + rtol |y_dense|) <= 1e-6; the observed maximum is reported

S3_allocation.asserted: zero allocation requests between consecutive accepted steps after one warm-up step (the last step excluded), 2D Brusselator Periodic 16 x 16
S3_allocation.measured_and_reported: the same count for 2D Brusselator Periodic 96 x 96; faer chooses its simplicial or supernodal numeric LU inside SparseDirectSolver (rodas5p-core, outside this node's write scope); a nonzero count there is reported as a FAIL of the allocation contract in that regime, not hidden

S_sparse_lu_client.S4_errors: a pattern without a diagonal entry is refused at construction (InvalidInput); a non-finite Jacobian value is a NonFinite error of linearize or factor (the driver rejects the attempt)
